lines.text: Foundation models unlocked unstructured data. The bigger prize is streaming data: which payment to stop, when the pump will fail.
Now I B M Granite Time Series models are live on Confluent, and work on series they have never seen.
They tell you what comes next, how far it sits from normal, which history matches, and which settings hit the target.
Confluent streams and governs the data with zero configuration, so models see live signals.
That changes the economics: no bespoke model per series, no months of expert work, no safety margins.
No data science army: a demand planner, a fraud analyst or a process engineer runs them on their own streams.
On a factory line, it forecasts the shift, flags a slow drift, and finds the last run like this.
Forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization and search, on every stream. Contact us to start with yours.
